invariants.rule: The normal worker-facing orchestration surface should remain minimal: ENTER -> WORK -> SUBMIT_AND_NEXT -> ... -> DONE/WAIT. New coordination responsibilities belong below this interface unless evidence shows the worker must know them.
invariants.challenge_gate: Controlled comparison against a known-good simple loop with no material loss in correctness, continuity or throughput.

invariants.rule: Claims, leases, stale detection, rescue, routing, scheduler state, telemetry and durable recovery are runtime responsibilities by default, not worker cognitive responsibilities.
invariants.challenge_gate: Show that exposing the responsibility to workers measurably improves outcomes without increasing protocol failure.

invariants.rule: Successful publication and acquisition of the next compatible task should be one logical transition from the worker perspective whenever safe. Avoid an idle discovery gap after every completion.
invariants.challenge_gate: Demonstrate a separate transition is required and does not reduce chaining reliability.

invariants.rule: A worker incarnation ENTERs once and remains resident across useful sequential work until DONE, a real boundary, hard cap, or deliberate reincarnation policy. Do not re-bootstrap full Prometeo between ordinary tasks.
invariants.challenge_gate: Evidence that repeated cold boot improves quality enough to offset transition cost and failure surface.

invariants.rule: Durable task/slot state outranks the biography of one chat. A chat is replaceable; task ownership, evidence and logical worker slot survive it.
invariants.challenge_gate: Explicit human/product requirement for persistent personal agent identity.

invariants.rule: Loss of a chat must be a routine recoverable runtime event, not a human archaeology event. A replacement receives the smallest sufficient durable state and continues without recap.
invariants.challenge_gate: None for recoverability; implementation details may evolve.

invariants.rule: Lease expiry, rescue priority, stale-result rejection and reallocation are enforced by durable runtime semantics. Workers may observe results but must not be the sole authority.
invariants.challenge_gate: Equivalent or stronger transactional proof.

invariants.rule: Operational completion is distinct from intellectual/product validity. Producer self-report never alone upgrades DONE to PASS/VERIFIED/CURRENT/SERVED.
invariants.challenge_gate: Only when a task contract makes production mechanically self-verifying and that equivalence is proven.

invariants.rule: Guides coordinate strategy, authority, experiments and systemic repair. Ordinary per-task scheduling and NEXT transitions must not require Guide mediation.
invariants.challenge_gate: A genuinely high-authority task class may require Guide approval, but routine queue flow remains independent.

invariants.rule: TV/Live/UI is an observer/projection of durable evidence. Turning it off must not change correctness, assignment, recovery or authority.
invariants.challenge_gate: None; interactive control actions must still write through canonical runtime APIs.

invariants.rule: A proposed improvement carries the burden of preserving known-good capabilities. Never replace a working path merely because a new architecture is cleaner.
invariants.challenge_gate: Explicit replacement authority plus equivalence/regression evidence.

invariants.rule: Keep the last known good behavior available as a control until its successor has beaten or matched it under comparable conditions.
invariants.challenge_gate: Only after a newer baseline is independently reproduced and promoted.

invariants.rule: When testing orchestration, begin with easy objectively evaluable tasks so scheduler/runtime failures are not confounded with reasoning difficulty; then climb a controlled complexity ladder.
invariants.challenge_gate: Experiment specifically targets difficult-task cognition rather than orchestration.

invariants.rule: Do not silently change code/protocol/evaluator during a measured run. A material change creates a new version/run.
invariants.challenge_gate: Emergency safety stop; affected run is classified contaminated.

invariants.rule: Any human rescue/routing/recap/merge action during an autonomy experiment is recorded as an event and counts against autonomy; it must never disappear from the result.
invariants.challenge_gate: None.

invariants.rule: A new coordination layer is not progress merely because it is sophisticated. It must solve a measured bottleneck and beat or preserve the baseline under regression tests.
invariants.challenge_gate: Measured evidence.

invariants.rule: On orchestration failure, first localize the failed transition and attempt removal/fusion/server-side hiding before adding a new worker-visible mechanism.
invariants.challenge_gate: Evidence that missing functionality, not excess interaction, is the cause.

invariants.rule: A capability that only works in a highly primed long chat is not considered durably solved. Important runtime/method changes require a fresh-agent or reincarnation check.
invariants.challenge_gate: Purely local non-agent implementation detail.

invariants.rule: Claims about success, scaling, learning or autonomy require durable exercised evidence, not architecture prose, worker confidence or a visually convincing TV state.
invariants.challenge_gate: None.

invariants.rule: Before changing architecture, a Guide must read Design DNA, relevant failure vaccines, last known good baseline and current exact state; then declare what it changes, must preserve, could regress, how it will be tested and how to rollback.
invariants.challenge_gate: Emergency reversible repair may proceed only with an explicit boundary receipt and immediate follow-up audit.
